Minting the single top-level category the content calls for, with no forced sub-hierarchy, per the discipline of minting exactly one node.

placements.why: All five segments are facets of one directional subject: Meridian deploys now require a signed release manifest (src-1), a requirement grounded in a specific past lapse where unsigned artifacts reached staging (src-2, evidence for the theme rather than its own leaf per the narrative-vs-fact grain test), and the memo's structured Gate/Scope/Owner triad (src-3, src-4, src-5) which fixes the rule, its reach across staging and production, and its accountable owner. This is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — whether the gate is extended to other release trains, whether it holds under pressure, whether ownership changes — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or hub was supplied to reuse, so this mints as the seed of the theme.
